\subsection{Experiment 06: Novelty-filter $\tau$ and the communication Pareto frontier}

\subsubsection{Experimental objective}

Sweep the novelty threshold $\tau$, entropy-code the actually transmitted bases, identify the Pareto-optimal (bits, SSIM) operating points with a knee-point flag, fit per-round exponential decay, and decompose the uplink.

\subsubsection{Scientific findings}

\paragraph{F-E06-01.} tau=0.30 is Pareto-optimal and the knee point: SSIM 0.7208 (99.6\% of the tau=0.99 maximum) at 39.55 KB (33.8\% of the 117.21 KB uplink). Numerical evidence: EXP6\_DF recorded rows; algorithmic non-dominated filter + chord-distance knee. Interpretation: A low novelty threshold retains essentially all reconstruction quality while eliminating ~2/3 of the uplink.. Limitations: Single run per tau; one scene (dino ring); one variant (F-SIBS\_1).. Supporting: Fig.~\ref{fig:exp06-tau-pareto-frontier}, Table~\ref{tab:exp06-tau-pareto}.

\paragraph{F-E06-02.} The interior thresholds tau=0.60 and tau=0.90 are dominated: more uplink did not yield higher SSIM than tau=0.30 in the recorded run. Numerical evidence: EXP6\_DF: tau=0.60 42.22 KB / SSIM 0.7119; tau=0.90 66.54 KB / SSIM 0.7195 vs tau=0.30 39.55 KB / SSIM 0.7208. Interpretation: The (bits, SSIM) response to tau is non-monotonic; conservative operating points should be taken from the frontier, not from the middle of the grid.. Limitations: n=1 per tau; dispersion unmeasured here.. Supporting: Fig.~\ref{fig:exp06-tau-pareto-frontier}, Table~\ref{tab:exp06-tau-pareto}.

\paragraph{F-E06-03.} Per-round transmitted-basis counts decay across rounds and are overlaid with the first-order theoretical bound; fitted and theoretical lambdas are reported per tau. Numerical evidence: exp6\_tau\_pareto\_table.csv fit columns; semi-log figure. Interpretation: Consistent with the novelty-filter model; reported as descriptive reference, not a theoretical claim.. Limitations: Bound uses the actual cumulative dictionary size; solid-angle argument is first-order.. Supporting: Fig.~\ref{fig:exp06-transmitted-decay}, Table~\ref{tab:exp06-tau-pareto}.

\subsubsection{Limitations}

Single run per $\tau$ (seed 42) on one scene and one variant; the frontier is descriptive and its dispersion is not measured here (multi-trial evidence at $\tau=0.95$ exists in Experiment 05).
